data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate made a loss of $12.4 (2015: loss of $38.0) of which $17.1 was attributable to prior years.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net release on prior years amounting to $17.1m (a favourable movement), representing approximately a 3.7% release relative to opening gross claims outstanding (prior year gross claims ~457.8m). The managing agent attributes the movement to favourable prior-year claims development and related reinsurance recoveries rather than a current-year underwriting performance shift.
raw_causal_phrases: of which $17.1 was attributable to prior years.
data.data_quality_notes: Extraction uncertainty: source PDFs were provided as images. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Statement of Financial Position (Liabilities) prior-year column (appears as 457.8). Prior year development taken from the Managing Agent's result breakdown sentence stating '$17.1 was attributable to prior years' (interpreted as a release). No clear labelled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross-column figure was unambiguously readable; segmental premium mix and detailed claims development triangle could not be reliably extracted from the images and are omitted. Amounts are in the native currency (USD millions). Confidence scores reflect OCR/visual uncertainty.
